name: app
description: AroCrypt is a tool for encryption and decryption text and files, steganography with auto encryption.

paragraphs: AroCrypt is a next-gen, cross-platform encryption toolkit built to keep your data locked down with zero friction. Encrypt text, files, and even images using strong, battle-tested cryptography. The interface stays clean, fast, and developer-friendly while the security stays airtight. Whether you're protecting personal notes or building secure workflows, AroCrypt delivers serious protection without the complexity.
features: Secure plain text using strong AES encryption with safe shareable output.
Encrypt or decrypt any file format with reliable AES encryption. Outputs .arocrypt secure containers.
Hide files inside .png images with automatic encryption. Only the correct private key can extract the content.
